newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon CPI rises 5.2 pct in 1996 - Banque Audi.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon CPI rises 5.2 pct in 1996 - Banque Audi.

text.p: Lebanon's Consumer Price Index rose 5.2 percent in 1996 compared with a 9.9 percent increase in 1995, Banque Audi said in its latest economic report issued on Monday.

"Compared to 1995, the slowing down of growth came in a context of nine percent growth of capital inflows, the stabilisation of inflation at 5.2 percent and the improvement of the ratio of cover of imports by exports at 2.7 percent," the report for the final quarter of 1996 said.
